links.outcome: Depression and anxiety symptom trajectories (PHQ-2, GAD-2) over six weeks, AI platform vs care-as-usual
links.effect: Flourish beat control on depression (condition × time β = −0.043; p = .006) and anxiety (β = −0.058; p = .001). Among elevated-symptom participants, meaningful change was 52.3% vs 31.7% for depression and 50.6% vs 38.1% for anxiety.
links.quote: Flourish produced more favorable symptom trajectories than control for depression (condition × time: β = −0.043; p = .006) and anxiety (β = −0.058; p = .001).

screen.reason: Randomized clinical trial of a patient-facing conversational generative AI platform (Flourish) evaluating clinical efficacy versus care-as-usual, but it does not compare specific guardrails or deployment practices.
